title: Case 039: Washing Machine Repair Request
initial_request:
Washing machine clicking while rotating -it doesn’t sound healthy.
It is still working at this point.
overview: The tenant reported that the washing machine clicked while rotating but remained operational. Northbridge Lettings checked whether anything inside the machine was causing the noise, contacted the landlord, and arranged for an appliance engineer to inspect it. An appointment was booked for the mapped Monday, 13 September 2025, between 12 and 2. The provider later confirmed the work was done and sent an invoice; the request was closed after the final checks.
outcome: The provider confirmed that the washing machine repair was completed and attached an invoice. The request was closed after the final checks.
